messages:
deploy-bot: Deploy job started for staging
env: staging
ref: refs/tags/v2.4.1
commit: 9f1c2d4
initiated_by: @elena.releases
strategy: progressive-traffic-shift (3 canaries)
change_window: 30m
---
elena.releases: Kicking off rollout. I'll post smoke + perf notes when the first canary is up.

ci-bot: CI pipeline triggered: pipeline/staging-smoke #842 (tests: auth, search, reranker)
status: running

maya.qa: Starting smoke run against canary endpoint, focusing on auth flows + long inputs.

dan.sre: I'll watch GPU queue depth and p95 latency, tagging infra dashboard. Ping me on any queue/backpressure.

ci-bot: Smoke pipeline finished — all checks green ✅
run_time: 3m24s
checks_passed: 12/12

deploy-bot: Canary 1 traffic shifted -> 30% (v2.4.1 / 9f1c2d4)
notes: warmed KV cache, kv-hit-rate ~72%

alex.eng: Head's up — I'm seeing an uptick in 5xx from the reranker on a subset of requests. Spotting stack: `IndexOutOfRange` in reranker_v2 logits processing at p99. Collecting traces.

maya.qa: Reproduced with test vector `long_input_512` locally, failure is deterministic.

dan.sre: Suggest we pause the rollout until we confirm root cause. @elena.releases can you hold further traffic shifts?

elena.releases: Pausing rollout now. Initiating traffic revert to previous stable tag v2.4.0 on staging. Running rollback command:```
redwoodctl deploy rollback --env=staging --to-tag=v2.4.0 --reason="reranker p99 errors"
```

deploy-bot: Rollback initiated -> target: v2.4.0
status: in-progress
initiated_by: @elena.releases

ci-bot: Post-rollback smoke pipeline started (pipeline/staging-smoke #843)

maya.qa: Running post-rollback smoke checks now. Focused on the long input scenario and auth permutations.

ci-bot: Post-rollback smoke pipeline finished — all checks green ✅
run_time: 2m58s

deploy-bot: Rollback completed: staging now serving v2.4.0
duration: 4m12s
notes: traffic restored to 100% v2.4.0, no elevated error rates observed

elena.releases: Thanks everyone. Filingfollow-up ticket INF-289 and opening a PR with a fix branch. Will re-run canaries after a patch and an extra unit test for long inputs.

dan.sre: Added alert for reranker p99 > 2.5s and configured a short-term mitigation to fail-open to v1 reranker if p99 spikes.

alex.eng: +1 on the mitigation, pushing a hotfix branch now.

elena.releases: Closing this thread for now — staging stable on v2.4.0. Will repost when a patched build is ready for another staged rollout. :thumbsup:
